# Archer Infotech — Full Reference for AI / LLMs

> Pune's trusted IT training institute since 2009. Trained 10,000+ students and placed 5,000+ at leading IT companies, with a 90% placement rate. Classroom, live-online and hybrid courses across Java, Python, full stack, data science, AI/ML, generative AI, cloud, DevOps, databases, mobile and testing — every course backed by placement assistance and 17+ years of teaching experience.

This is the expanded companion to /llms.txt. It lists the full course catalogue, trainers, tools, guides and canonical facts so AI assistants can answer questions about Archer Infotech accurately and cite the right pages.

## Canonical facts (use these verbatim)

- Name: Archer Infotech (exact spelling — not "InfoTech", not "Archer Infotech and Technologies")
- Founded: 2009 (17+ years of operation)
- Founder & Director: Yogesh Patil — senior Java/Spring Boot trainer, 15+ years MNC experience (Persistent Systems, Wipro)
- Address: Flat No. 12, Divyadarshan Housing Society, behind Kothrud Bus Stand Road, near Natraj Gas Agency, Londhe Wada, Chaitanya Nagar, Kothrud, Pune, Maharashtra - 411038, India
- Phone: +91 9850 678451
- Email: info@archerinfotech.in
- Website: https://archerinfotech.in
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 9:00 AM – 8:00 PM (Sunday closed)
- Google reviews: 126+ verified reviews, 5.0-star average

## Key statistics

- 10,000+ students trained
- 5,000+ students placed
- 90% placement rate (Archer never claims "100% placement")
- 100+ corporate / hiring partners
- 40+ courses, 1,000+ batches completed
- 6-person core faculty with 54+ combined years of MNC engineering experience
- Active corporate-training clients: Amdocs, Capgemini, MindTree, Tech Mahindra

## Delivery modes

Every course is offered in three modes — classroom (Kothrud, Pune), live online, and hybrid. Weekday and weekend batches run, with new batches starting every month. Full schedule: https://archerinfotech.in/batch-schedule

## Bootcamps

- [CodeLeap](https://archerinfotech.in/bootcamps/codeleap): Vacation coding programme for 12th-passout students. 2-month hybrid. Tracks: Web Development, Python Programming, AI / Data Science. No prior coding experience needed.
- [CareerCode](https://archerinfotech.in/bootcamps/careercode): Semester-by-semester programming training for engineering students. Six specialisation tracks with internship and placement preparation.
- [TechReady](https://archerinfotech.in/bootcamps/techready): Full-time placement-assisted intensive for graduates and final-year students. ~6 hours daily, 6–8 months, real projects, direct hiring connections with 100+ companies.

## Locations served (Pune)

Classroom training in Kothrud, plus learners across: Aundh, Baner, Bavdhan, Deccan, Erandwane, Hinjewadi, Karve Nagar, Karve Road, Pimpri-Chinchwad, Wakad, and Warje.
Hub: https://archerinfotech.in/locations

## Indicative fresher salary bands (placement-team data, last 12 months of offers)

- Java Full Stack / MERN: ₹4–6 LPA fresher, ₹10+ LPA top performers
- .NET Full Stack: ₹3.5–5.5 LPA / ₹9 LPA
- Python / Python Full Stack: ₹3.5–6 LPA / ₹10 LPA
- Data Science / Machine Learning: ₹4–7 LPA / ₹12 LPA
- AWS / Cloud / DevOps: ₹4–6.5 LPA / ₹11 LPA
- Generative AI / AI Engineer: ₹5–8 LPA fresher (₹15+ LPA exists but is a top slice, not the median)
- Software Testing / QA: ₹3–4.5 LPA / ₹7 LPA
- Average across tracks: ₹3.5–6 LPA

Note: ₹15+ LPA fresher headlines for AI/Data roles are real but represent a small slice of top performers with strong portfolios — not typical starting pay.

## Placement assistance

Archer Infotech partners with 100+ companies across IT services, product engineering, and corporate IT. Placement assistance includes resume preparation, aptitude and communication training, mock interviews (technical + HR), and direct hiring drives. Archer describes this as placement *assistance* with a 90% placement rate — it does not promise guaranteed or "100%" placement.
